set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- One checked-in command runs formatting, compilation, applicable MiMa, JVM and Node tests, Chromium tests, optimized Scala.js links, representation proof, NumPy parity, docs, artifact inspection, and fresh consumers.
- Shell-based NumPy and consumer checks are invoked by the authoritative entry point rather than omitted from an sbt-only alias.
- Protected-branch CI and tag publication invoke the same entry point.
- Every selected published module receives equivalent platform coverage.
- Failure in any component prevents signing and publication.
- The command passes from a clean candidate checkout and emits durable receipts.
set.title: Create one authoritative core release gate
